mechanism: Propranolol inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of prochlorperazine, increasing its levels; additive CNS depression and potential for orthostatic hypotension and increased QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine adverse effects (sedation, hypotension, arrhythmias); consider dosage adjustment of prochlorperazine or use alternative antiemetic; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
